blocks.text: Facts here come from the municipality, TransLink or BC Transit, the Ministry of Education and Child Care, and the retailers’ own pages, listed under Sources. Walking and driving times were measured on OpenStreetMap routing on November 2, 2026, from the point named under the table.

items.t: No rapid-transit station is in Delta. Nearest: Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), terminus of TransLink Route 601 from South Delta.
Nearest bus exchange: South Delta Exchange, served by Routes 601, 604 and 614.
Route 604 English Bluff/Bridgeport Station (TransLink): via South Delta Exchange, 56 St, 12 Ave, English Bluff Rd and 1 Ave; peak trips to Bridgeport Station.
Route 614 English Bluff/South Delta Exchange (TransLink): loop via 1 Ave, English Bluff Rd and 12 Ave.
Route 601 Bridgeport Station/South Delta (TransLink): via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station.
Fred Gingell Park, 253 English Bluff Rd, Delta.
South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 St, Delta.

faq.q: Which elementary school is in English Bluff?
faq.a: English Bluff Elementary School, 402 English Bluff Road; the SD37 School Locator result for that address pairs it with South Delta Secondary (750 53 St) — confirm the catchment for a specific address in the locator.

faq.q: Does the bluff affect building or renovating?
faq.a: Yes. Development Permit Area SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment), Category "b" in OCP Bylaw No. 8400, addresses mud flows, debris flows, erosion, land slip and subsidence, and development affected by hazardous conditions is subject to conditions set by a suitably qualified Professional Engineer.

faq.q: Who owns the beach below a waterfront house?
faq.a: The foreshore below the natural boundary is Crown land, and Delta notes foreshore use is interjurisdictional — upland ownership alone does not grant foreshore use.

faq.q: Where are the parks and beach access?
faq.a: Fred Gingell Park, 253 English Bluff Rd, has stairs from the upper park down to the beach, and Diefenbaker Park, 5579 1 Ave, is the other named park serving this shore.

faq.q: Can a lot add a suite or coach house?
faq.a: Delta's Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing zoning allows up to four units on single-detached and duplex lots, subject to the bylaw and to any slope or streamside permit area on the lot — on this shore, the SD2 hazard conditions are the deciding layer.
